target_customer: Diners using mobile phones to find restaurants nearby
problem: Finding a place to eat when out meant scanning text lists of reviews. YumDots planned interactive maps of local restaurants on mobile as a more efficient view than mobile review services.
business_model: Free consumer mobile app, monetization not stated

competitors.name: Urbanspoon iPhone app
competitors.what: Restaurant finder with shake to pick feature
competitors.traction_then: Reported among the most downloaded iPhone apps soon after launch

competitors.name: TripAdvisor Local Picks
competitors.what: Free iPhone restaurant finder with a map and tap to call

technical_complexity.rationale: A map mashup over restaurant data on mobile, which was a standard build in 2008. Getting restaurant data and mobile reach were harder than the code.

defensibility.rationale: A map view over third party review data was easy to copy and Yelp, Urbanspoon and others already held the review content.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competing iPhone restaurant apps launched in July 2008. No acquisition of YumDots found.

market_need_then: Mobile local search was growing and the iPhone App Store opened in July 2008, but the YC description shows the product was pre launch at the time of the batch.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found beyond a TechCrunch Demo Day list entry.

outcome_analysis: YumDots joined YC in Winter 2008 with a map based mobile restaurant finder that said it was launching soon. The company later became inactive. No post mortem, press or acquisition was found, so the cause of the shutdown is not public. Strong competing restaurant apps arrived on the iPhone within months of the batch, but no source ties the shutdown to them.
notes: The YC page has an empty founders section, so founders are unknown. Seed round rests on a single database (CB Insights) with no amount. yumdots.com did not resolve in this session (possibly dead or blocked), so no site content was read. The two competitor sources are dated about six months after the January 2008 batch start, noted per audit lesson 5. Confidence is low.
